_comment: Registry of every clip in the evaluation set. This is the SINGLE source of
videomae_boundary.py and refresh_run_reports.py all read it, so adding a clip
requires no code changes. Use add_clip.py rather than editing by hand.
name        display name used in every table and figure
video       source .mp4 (gitignored; must be present to re-run the pipeline)
results_dir folder holding features.csv and segmentation_results.json
fps         effective processing rate of the saved run, NOT the source fps
split       'dev' = may inform tuning | 'heldout' = never used for tuning

clips.name: YT build B1
clips.note: Contains a ~10.5s screen recording of a web store spliced onto the front, then a hard cut to the overhead desk shot. Edited, not continuous. Unannotated: excluded from all evaluation until it has steps.
